duplication.why: The diff adds no copy of its own, but the holiday-match rule still exists in three places, and only one of them learned the MM-DD form.

placement.why: Holiday matching is changed in shared/schedules.ts, where the weekend and holiday logic lives.

scope.why: The change is one predicate plus a test.

maintainability.why: The new form is understood only by the shared helper, while the app.ts copies keep exact-date matching, so the holiday rule now depends on the code path.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The diff's own code uses isWeekendOrHoliday. The pre-existing inline checks in server/schedules/app.ts that bypass it are left untouched.
